goal: Add the domain function that counts the books in each status, so a later task can show the counts on the page. No page change in this task.
inputs: src/books.ts holds the pure domain functions; add the new one there.
Put its unit tests in a new file, tests/stats.test.ts, and leave tests/books.test.ts as it is.
Status and STATUSES in src/books.ts list the three statuses.

acceptance_criteria.statement: countByStatus(books) returns an object with one entry for each of 'to-read', 'reading' and 'done', giving how many books have that status.
countByStatus does not change the array it is given or any book in it.
